{{Quote|A grown-up version of the kiddie favorite! Indulge your sweet tentacle with one of these giant, crispy squares today. Coated with charmed quark frosting, they're just	about the most decadent treat you can find this side	of the Zabian system!|Dex's Diner menu|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Sticky sweetmallow squares''' were a type of decadent [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]] made with [[Sweetmallow/Legends|sweetmallow]] and coated with [[quark frosting]]. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the squares in what its menu described as a 'grown-up' version of the kiddie favorite. The diner sold the sticky sweetmallow squares for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sticky sweetmallow squares were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
